etymology.historical_story: If this token refers to Baylor University, its institutional name commemorates Judge Robert Emmett Bledsoe Baylor. The university's account explains that other names were considered before Baylor was selected for the institution chartered in 1845. This documents the university's naming, not the deeper origin of the surname or the unidentified lowercase input. [Baylor official history](https://about.web.baylor.edu/heritage/baylor-history/naming-baylor)
